# What does a party bus charter really make? True profit, margin and the lowest quote

> Free calculator for party bus, limo and shuttle charter operators. Enter the charter price, hours and minimum, driver and deadhead time, miles, fuel, vehicle cost and yearly overhead; it shows true profit per charter, profit per vehicle hour and the lowest quote for your margin. Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
